races.display_title: British Stallion Studs EBF Maiden Fillies' Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict: A maiden to keep a close eye on moving forward with some excellent pedigrees/yards on show. CLOAK OF POWER is bred in the purple and holds a Group 1 entry, so she edges the vote before market clues. Usaylah seems sure to build on her debut promise for a yard with an excellent recent record in this race, while Marylebone and Antonova are 2 other very appealing debutants to take seriously. CLOAK OF POWER (IRE) MARYLEBONE (FR) ANTONOVA

races.verdict: PIXIE DIVA should be sharper with a recent outing under her belt and is too well handicapped to ignore under Oisin Murphy. Kinetic Force and Billy Loughnane's mount Fiorella Princess are others who could go well, while the class-dropping Marching Mac would be a threat to all if the ground goes on the soft side. PIXIE DIVA KINETIC FORCE FIORELLA PRINCESS (IRE)

races.display_title: Midnite Ain't Your Grandad's Bookie Handicap
races.verdict: Preference is for POCKLEY , who left behind his first 2 efforts of the season when making the frame here 4 days ago. The 10-time course winner is taken to build on that effort to add to his tally, with Spirited Dancer feared most having shaped well in 2 starts for her current yard. Auntie Jo completes the shortlist. POCKLEY SPIRITED DANCER AUNTIE JO

races.verdict: MYTHICAL ROCK signalled he is ready to double his tally when runner-up at Bellewstown last time and with that form having been well advertised since he gets the nod. La Tulipe Noire caught the eye when sixth here recently and could emerge as the main danger from a falling mark, although Jasmine Affanalis , Zipster and No More Porter all need factoring into this very open handicap too. MYTHICAL ROCK (IRE) LA TULIPE NOIRE (IRE) JASMINE AFFANALIS (IRE)
